packageRules.description: CI proves GitHub Actions updates, so passing minor, patch and pin updates merge themselves once their PR passes CI.
CI proves dev tooling updates, so passing minor, patch and pin updates merge themselves once their PR passes CI.

Our own packages arrive together, majors included, as soon as they publish and outside the PR limits. A bump changes what sites look like, so its PR needs screenshots and is never automerged. Keep this rule last so it wins. Commits use chore, so a site bump never triggers a release.
